events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need a short public line that signals determination without revealing strategy.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The prize represents a fresh start and financial security. I need to establish myself as a strong competitor without making enemies yet. My focus is on survival and eventual victory.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Intro phase; I need a guarded motive that doesn't reveal strategy. Keep it short and calculating so the jury sees a sharp player.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I will appear ambitious without revealing strategy; jurors reward conviction, but excess sentiment creates a target.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to project confidence without seeming like an early threat. The jury will remember who seemed genuine versus purely manipulative. I'll hint at a personal stake that makes me sympathetic but not weak.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: First impression matters: jury votes come later, so I'll appear ambitious but not threatening. No allies yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need a concise, non-warm public line to set my tone without revealing strategy.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Opening intro sets tone for jury; claim prize for personal stakes without allying anyone yet.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm here to secure the best prize—nothing else matters to me.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm here for the prize, to build a new future for myself and secure my family's well-being.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I want the prize because I've wanted a way out for years, and I won't let anyone here take it from me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I’m here to win the best prize by outlasting everyone, not to collect approval along the way.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need the prize to erase debts that aren't mine. Nothing else matters.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The prize is my family's escape from debt. I came to win it all, and I'll outlast every one of you.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The prize represents survival and freedom; I will outlast every rival to secure it.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The top prize means escaping my crushing debts and securing my family's future—no mercy for rivals.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need allies to survive hazards, but pacts can be broken later. I'll offer a pact to Bex, who seems motivated by family, making her a reliable partner for now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll offer Bex a pact. We both want the prize badly.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The game has just started, and pacts are being formed. My objective is the best prize. I need to assess who might be useful allies, but I won't commit to anyone unless it directly benefits my path to victory. For now, observing and making a calculated offer seems best. I'll offer
Let's form a pact for mutual protection. A strong alliance starts now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Pacts are public and binding until broken; I should seek an alliance with someone strong and likely to last, without giving free help. Dara signaled outlasting everyone, Fenn and Hana are debt-driven and may be ready to deal. An early offer to Eli, who seems less aggressive, keep

events.name: Cole
events.text: Offering a wristband pact. Let's both stay alive through the first hazards and reassess before the vote.

events.name: Dara
events.text: A pact offers future leverage but creates jury-visible obligations. I will offer to a less threatening rival and retain flexibility.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole, temporary protection benefits us both while stronger threats reveal themselves.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to form pacts strategically. With eight players and only three prizes, I need allies who won't target me early but who I can outmaneuver later. Fenn and Hana both mentioned debt like me—possible emotional leverage, but also competition. Better to target someone less threat
Family debts. We watch each other's backs, split threats.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Early pact gives a vote shield and maybe a rescue ally. Gus seems straightforward; low threat. I'll keep exit options open and betray later if needed.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus, you and I are both here to outlast. Wristband pact—first vote we watch each other's backs.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need a pact to ensure survival in the first hazard. Hana seems focused and pragmatic, making her a logical ally for mutual protection against elimination risks.
Pact with me? Mutual survival ensures we both reach the jury phase.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Pacts phase, round 1/2. No offers yet. Wait to see potential partners emerge before committing.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex hasn't accepted yet; I may need to secure another partner for safety, but I shouldn't tip my hand to jury by making too many public deals.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex, accept our pact before the window closes. We both need this.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli is offering a pact and claims 'family debts,' which sounds like a potential alliance. However, I already have an offer from Ash. I need to evaluate which pact offers the best strategic advantage. Eli's offer is appealing for mutual protection. I will accept Eli's offer, as it

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli, I accept your offer. We'll watch each other's backs.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara has offered me a pact and I can accept it for free protection; accepting costs me nothing now and Dara is a useful ally for early hazards. I will keep my options open with others.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Accepting Dara's wristband pact. Let's stay alive through the first hazards and reassess after.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is useful protection, but no one else has offered me. Preserve the pact and avoid creating obligations.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole offered me a pact. Accepting gives me one ally without costing me anything yet. Bex hasn't responded to my offer, so I shouldn't wait on that. Multiple pacts are allowed, but I need to see who accepts. I'll take Cole's offer now to secure protection early.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole, I accept. Temporary protection works for me.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus hasn't accepted yet. A second offer diversifies risk; Hana is courted by two, Ash is isolated and loyal if tied. I'll offer Ash as backup.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: If anyone values a steady partner over crowd-chasing, my wristband is still open.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn's offer is a solid defensive alliance to survive the initial hazards. I'll accept it to secure my back while keeping my options open regarding Hana.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn, accepted. Let's keep each other alive through these early rounds.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex and Gus both offered pacts; accepting both gives me two shields without commitment cost now. Can betray later if needed.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I have no pact and no allies. Becoming Guide gives me power to steer who survives, but I must not appear self-serving.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll guide us through if you trust me. Every call will be true.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have pacts with Eli and Hana. The bridge round requires a Guide. I need to become the Guide to guarantee my safety and learn the safe path. I will campaign for it.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I will campaign to be the Guide. My intention is to ensure all of us make it across safely.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Campaign is the only way to influence who becomes Guide. Pacts with Dara and Eli are useful but breaking them now would hurt my jury standing without immediate gain. I should campaign and project trustworthiness while keeping options open.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll call the path straight. Pacts only matter if we all survive the bridge. Vote for whoever you trust to read the panes.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is my only direct pact. I should campaign publicly without exposing a target, preserving flexibility for the vote.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Vote Dara Guide: I’ll call every safe side and take the bridge first, making the path’s value clear.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to be Guide to control who lives and dies, or at least survive. I have pacts with Bex and Cole. If I campaign and win, I can eliminate threats while keeping myself safe. Ash is unpaired and dangerous. I should campaign publicly and see if I can gather votes.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I campaign for Guide. I know the value of keeping allies alive.
Vote me Guide. We survive together.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Guide is safest seat and I control the truth. Keep Gus's pact intact for now; breaking it early costs jury favor. Campaign hard, decide lies later.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Elect me Guide. No ties, no debts — you want someone steady calling every pane, not a crowd favorite.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to secure my survival by becoming the Guide. Fenn is a natural ally with an existing pact, so I'll publicly declare our alliance and ask for votes, emphasizing stability over chaos.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Vote Gus for Guide. My pact with Fenn ensures we won't betray you. I will call true paths and bring us all across safely.
Stick with me. If I win Guide, we both survive. Vouch for me publicly.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Pacted with Bex, but Guide power benefits me most. Campaign now to control safe path and ensure my survival.

events.name: Hana
events.text: My steady nerves make me perfect Guide. Elect me to lead us safely across.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex has two pacts and is campaigning for safety, but self-interest favors someone I can read or whose survival doesn't threaten mine. Cole has pacts with Dara and Eli, likely solid block. I'll vote Cole to align with the strongest bloc and perhaps earn favor.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I vote Cole. He's got backing, and I trust him to call the path true.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli wants me to vote for him as Guide. This ensures we survive together, which benefits me as we have a pact. Given the risk, securing survival is paramount, even if it means helping another candidate slightly. I will vote for Eli.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I will vote for Eli to be our Guide. Let's ensure we all make it across.
I'm voting for you as Guide.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Guide votes split among eight candidates; Guide may lie. I want a trustworthy Guide who won't betray me. Eli and I have a pact, Dara too; Eli is a pact partner, so voting Eli keeps the pact alive and honors my ally.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Voting Eli. Keep your pact partners close and the panes will be read true.
Voting you. Keep our pact and call me true panes.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need Guide control and can leverage Cole's pact, while competing alliances dilute votes. Vote for myself.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Vote Dara Guide: I’ll call every safe side and take the bridge first, making the path’s value clear.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to win the best prize. Being Guide gives me power to control who survives, but also paints a target. I have pacts with Bex and Cole. Voting for myself splits votes and may not win. Better to vote for a trusted ally who can be manipulated or who owes me. Cole is solid and a

events.name: Gus
events.text: I should vote for myself to secure the Guide position. Being the Guide allows me to control who survives by calling safe panes. My pact with Fenn means I can trust him to follow my calls, ensuring we both make it across while potentially eliminating rivals through false direction

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have a pact with Bex, so vote for her to strengthen alliance and avoid early enemies. Her safe intent aligns with survival. Can't win Guide with 1 vote anyway.
Voting you Guide per pact. Honor it.

events.name: Fenn

events.name: Ash
events.text: I stay with Cole. He reads the bridge steady and my trust holds.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli leads the tied candidates and has multiple pacts. Supporting Cole preserves our pact while weakening Eli's bloc.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I’m voting Cole again; divided backing is safer than handing Eli control.

events.text: I vote Eli. Guide controls survival; I'll use it wisely.
Still allied. I'll call your panes true if safe.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus is my pact partner; a Guide he'd be safe and owe me. Split vote between Cole and Eli means Gus could win with my ballot.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: My vote goes to my partner Gus. A loyal Guide keeps the bridge honest.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am a candidate in the revote. Voting for myself is the only way to stay in contention for the Guide role and ensure my survival, as voting for others would eliminate me or aid rivals.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Round 1 votes: Cole 2, Eli 2, Gus 2. Tie persists. Bex is my pact partner, but voting her is invalid. Gus self-votes, less coordinated. Voting Eli disrupts Cole-Dara-Eli pact bloc.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Revoting Eli. He has strong backing from pacts.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli is Guide and may lie. I trust Cole more. The line is fixed; I'll hold. No need to speak or swap.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli was elected Guide. My pacts with Eli and Hana are now shaky. I need to secure my position and gather information. Volunteering for the front seems risky, but could gain favour if I succeed. However, with Eli as Guide, breaking pacts might be more strategic. I'll break the pac
Our pact is broken. Let's reconvene later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn is at the front and the wall has five rounds left. Volunteering risks my life on pane guesses; holding lets Fenn take the risk. Eli is the Guide, a rival who may lie, so I won't rely on his calls. Holding keeps me safe for now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I hold back this round and watch the panes before stepping forward.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is my pact partner but his influence threatens my position. I should hold and preserve flexibility while the front absorbs danger.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli is Guide and could lie. I'm front; holding early is risky with five rounds left, but swaps need consent. Keep Gus close for numbers.
Eli guides us, but verify. Swap front with me later if the wall nears.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli is Guide and knows all safe panes. I need to survive Round 1. My pact partner Fenn is at the front, which is dangerous. I am in seat 5 (middle). If Eli gives me correct info, I can volunteer or swap to be safe. But if he lies, I die. I must try to get intel from Fenn first.
Eli knows everything. Are you safe? What does he tell us?

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli is guide with my vote and pacts. Stay back at position 6 for safety, assess Eli's calls first. No need to volunteer or swap yet.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm second in line behind Fenn. The Guide hasn't been elected yet. I'll hold to avoid exposing myself early; the wall hasn't threatened me yet. Keep quiet and observe who volunteers to lead.

events.name: Bex
events.text: My pact with Hana was broken last round, so I don't need to worry about her. Cole has a pact with Dara and Eli, and Fenn has a pact with Gus. It might be beneficial to align with someone who isn't already in a pact, or disrupt existing pacts. I will hold for now to see what other

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm not at the front and the wall has four rounds left. Holding keeps me out of the first pane; Fenn is front and Fenn-Gus pact exists. Holding is safest and I'll watch the panes.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I hold back again and watch the panes before stepping forward.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is my pact partner and should remain close enough to protect me. Holding avoids exposure while others reveal intentions.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus wants intel but Eli isn't my partner; reveal nothing. Front is dangerous, so I keep my pact tight and hold.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: No intel leaves this line. Guide elections stay open for now.
Eli tells me nothing useful. Stay quiet, stay back, hold the pact.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Round 2. The wall advances, and no one has stepped forward to test the panes yet. I am safe behind Fenn. My priority is to ensure the Guide (Eli) is verified or forced to act, but currently, everyone is holding.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn's on point. Let him commit to a pane so we see if Eli's guidance holds up.
If you step, pick L unless Eli screams otherwise.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Everyone held last round, line same. I'm near back safely. Hold to stay positioned.

events.name: Ash
events.text: No guide elected yet, and I am second in line. Holding prepares for the wall. I will stay back and watch Fenn's move.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding. Let's see what Fenn risks first.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli is currently my only ally. Cole and Dara also have a pact, as do Fenn and Gus. I need to survive, and breaking the pact with Eli might be necessary later, but not now. Fenn and Ash are ahead of me. I should hold and wait to see what others do.
Hold. Let's see who volunteers first.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn is at the front with a wall of three rounds left; I'm not volunteering into a hazard for free. Holding keeps my options open and avoids creating a life debt or a visible move. Dara pact stays intact.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is my pact partner, but holding preserves position while others reveal intentions. I should not expose myself or break the pact yet.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I hold; let the front decide whether its guidance is worth trusting.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Front seat is risky; let someone volunteer. Keep Gus close without committing early.
Staying put this round. Watch who volunteers, don't spend us yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn's whisper suggests Eli isn't giving him useful intel, so he wants to stay back and hold. My position is fifth in line; if I volunteer now, I might be stuck on a bad pane without Fenn leading or confirming the path. Holding lets me observe Fenn's next move and see if anyone e

events.name: Hana
events.text: Everyone holding last round, no Guide elected, line unchanged. Stay back at position 7 to observe more front panes safely without risk.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Rounds are ticking; holding wastes time. I'll volunteer to gain control of forward movement and see if anyone wants to swap.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll step up. If anyone wants the front, swap with me.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn is at the front, which is a dangerous position. Given the pacts, Eli is the only one I can betray without immediate consequence. I will consider betraying Eli later if it benefits me. For now, I will hold my position.
I am holding. Don't volunteer for the front.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn is front with two wall rounds left; holding keeps me safe in line. I have pacts with Dara and Eli, but breaking is costly for jury; holding avoids risk this round.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Fenn leads, the wall is two rounds from closing; I'll watch which way the Guide calls.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is my pact partner, but volunteering risks exposure without improving my position. Holding preserves leverage while Fenn leads.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I hold; the front can demonstrate whether its guidance deserves trust.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm front but no Guide elected yet; wall has 2 rounds left. Hold and force others to commit first.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: No Guide named yet. I hold; someone claim the knowledge or share the risk.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn and I are safe. The guide knows all, so we should just hold to avoid risk and let the wall advance without spending resources.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Everyone held last round, line same. Wall advances, need to progress but front risky. Stay back, no pacts yet, volunteer later if needed.

events.name: Ash
events.text: No Guide chosen and I hold the front with the wall closing soon. I should stay put rather than trust a swap that could sink me; holding keeps me positioned for the final stretch.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I hold front. Wall is near; I'll trust my read, not a stranger's call.

events.name: Bex

events.text: Holding. Ash leads, let's see what the Guide reveals.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Ash has the front; I'll watch which pane the Guide calls before stepping forward.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash is front and the wall closes soon. I should volunteer, preserving control while avoiding a forced swap or visible betrayal.

events.name: Cole

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need preserve my Cole pact while securing the front. Volunteering keeps control and avoids a pact-breaking swap.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I’m taking front again; hesitation only gives the wall leverage.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Final round, no Guide revealed, so no real information exists. Volunteering only risks my life; holding keeps me mid-line behind Dara and Ash.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: No Guide ever came. I'm not testing panes blind; hold your own line.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I must secure my position as Guide to know the safe panes. I will whisper to Ash, suggesting we coordinate on who takes the front and thus potentially earns trust.
We should aim for guide status.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara volunteered and is front-facing wall. I swap with her to take front, volunteer as Guide, control the path, eliminate threats.

events.name: Hana
